descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B25 · P1 · 已知

养老院 dashboard 把所有住户都算进去（22 个，应为 19 个 In Today），取消 In Today 的住户还在上面

票：TFA-92587 AC6 ready for qa；TFA-92598 in progress · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：dev

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-09/S09, TC-20/S06, TC-20/S07

思路 / Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S04a 「养老院：In Today 是/否决定谁被算进去（TFA-92587 AC 6）」 Nursing Home: In Today yes/no decides who is counted (TFA-92587 AC 6)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U5 Nursing Home counts are based on the residents marked 'In Today'. Marking a resident adds them to the counts. Un-marking removes them from today's counts without deleting them from All Residents（UAT TC-09；TFA-92598 AC 4；TFA-92587 AC 6；TFA-92587 AC 2）

测试设计方法：决策表（decision-table） — 几个条件的组合列成表，每个组合各验一次，看结果是不是按规则变。

Given Seeded Nursing Home census of 7 residents: 5 marked In Today (2 pending, 1 pre-rounded, 1 in-encounter, 1 complete) and 2 not in today (1 pending, 1 complete). One In Today, pending resident on a second @roundai.test account. Plus the standard Hospital patient

When Open the Nursing Home list on Today's Visits, then open the dashboard from the bottom nav

Then Today's Visits lists the 5 In Today residents and not the other 2. The dashboard's Total is 5: the 2 residents who are not in today and the other physician's In Today resident are not counted

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Decision table on In Today yes/no: a resident is counted only when yes (TFA-92587 AC 6, TFA-92598 AC 4, UAT TC-09), and never another physician's resident. Checkpoint 1: mustContain N1–N5; mustNotContain N6, N7, the foreign resident and the Hospital patient. Checkpoint 2: counts Total 5 only; mustNotContain the foreign resident and the Hospital patient. …

在哪跑：dev 上的 datasets（种数据集跑列表）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S04a 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-20.matrix.json 里的编号；字母后缀 = 一个用例拆成了几条），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：已知产品问题 · 环境 dev + 本地 · 票 TFA-92587 ready for qa；TFA-92598 in progress

养老院 dashboard 把所有住户（22 个）都算进去，而不是只算标了 In Today 的 19 个，医生看到的总数里有今天不看的人。

The Nursing Home dashboard counts every resident (22) instead of only the 19 marked In Today, so the physician's totals include residents who are not being seen today.

依据：allure-results/6c897174…: NH dashboard Total 22 (7/9/6) vs 19 residents In Today; dev/datasets and 本地 datasets give the same result. Recorded: dev report §4 known gap (U57/U69/U56), TFA-92587 AC 6 / TFA-92598 AC 4; matrix U5 says it is ungated against 92587 AC 6.

并进来的：TC-20/S04a 本地 datasets (same failure, merged into this row)
